push.title: D 1-1 vs Louisville | You: 7.6
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.6 against Louisville. You battled, and battling's the part you can always control.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Louisville's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ Giveaways 6, down from your usual 13. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 4. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Team-high 1 key passes. That's growth you can count.

THE BAD
- Passes attempted 27, down from your usual 36. A little secret: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
- Tackles attempted 2, down from your usual 5. Coach's secret: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- 0.4 under usual. One fix and you're back on track.
- Key passes 1, down from your usual 2. Back to basics: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- A promotion match, and we drew it. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.

Five-minute drill: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

You've got more in you. I've seen it. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 1-1 vs Louisville | You: 6.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.5. Every great player has a night like this in their pocket. This is yours.

THE GOOD
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 1. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 1-1 with Louisville. We left a little on the table.

THE BAD
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Real quick: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 63% passing (17 of 27, down from your usual 80%). Here's the play: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. No sweat, just reps.
- You and Soup_Kitchen22 need to sync up on forcing passes: give each other short options.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Honest truth: that cost us.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. That's where the match slipped.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.5, down from your usual 8.5. I love you, but that wasn't football. That was a fire drill.

Try this in practice: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Kindness costs nothing and wins locker rooms.

Practice makes progress. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 1-1 vs Louisville | You: 6.4 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Soup_Kitchen22, your 3rd best match performance of the season with a 6.4. We can build on that.

THE GOOD
+ Passes attempted 17, up from your usual 10. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Your 3rd best match performance of the season, at 6.4. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Tackles attempted 4, up from your usual 2. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ 1-1 with Louisville. We'll sharpen the edges.

THE BAD
- You and BellyTb1 have a shared to-do on forcing passes: give each other short options.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 6.4 (best was PhogsToffees's 7.6). One honest look at that and we move forward.
- A promotion match, and we drew it. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 3). Between you and me: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 2 (best was BellyTb1's 0). It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 53% (9 of 17). If you did that at practice, we'd run laps till sunrise. Easy win: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Before next match: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

Soup_Kitchen22, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
